title: Left-right and top-bottom reflection errors diverge between Grades 2 and 3 in reversible-letter rotation judgments: reproducibility materials
description: Versioned reproducibility materials for the Cortex submission on reversible-letter rotation judgments. The archive contains analysis code, non-identifying aggregate results, figure-generation code, validation tests, and documentation of the restricted-data schema. Participant-level records are excluded because unrestricted public release is not covered by the original consent and ethics framework for this cohort of children.
